topic: Buying Eggs at the Farmers Market

script.title: MARKET DAY EGGS
script.story_hook: A cash-only egg stand tests a loyal shopper.
script.intro_zh: 只收現金的蛋攤，考驗一位老主顧。
script.welcome_en: Welcome! Today we shop for eggs at an open-air market. Listen for food words.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎！今天我們到戶外市集買雞蛋。留意食物的說法。
script.outro: Good eggs need good chats. Ask, taste, come back. See you Saturday!
script.outro_zh: 好蛋要配好聊天。問一問、嚐一嚐、下週再來。週六見！
script.practice_intro_en: One more listen, then repeat each line with a smile.
script.practice_intro_zh: 再聽一遍，帶著微笑把每行跟讀出來。
script.char_a_description: a retired man in his sixties with a shaved gray head, deep laugh lines, an olive field jacket over a plaid flannel shirt, sturdy walking shoes, a canvas tote bag
script.char_b_description: a lively woman in her early thirties with two dark braids tied back, a denim apron over a yellow checked shirt, sun freckles, standing behind stacked egg cartons

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Morning! How are the eggs today?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɔɹnɪŋ haʊ ɑɹ ði ɛɡz təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 早安！今天的雞蛋怎麼樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fresh this morning — look at those yolks!
dialogue.phonetic: /fɹɛʃ ðɪs ˈmɔɹnɪŋ lʊk æt ðoʊz jɔks/
dialogue.zh: 今天早上才生的，看那蛋黃！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mmm, I'll take a dozen, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /məm aɪl teɪk ə ˈdʌzən pliːz/
dialogue.zh: 好，請給我來一打。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How big — mediums or larges?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ bɪɡ ˈmidɪəmz ɔɹ ˈlɑɹdʒəz/
dialogue.zh: 要多大號？中號還是大號？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What do you suggest for baking?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt du ju səˈdʒɛst fɚ ˈbeɪkɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 烤蛋糕的話，你建議哪種？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mediums work for almost everything.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmidɪəmz wɜɹk fɚ ˈɔlmoʊst ˈɛvɹiθɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 中號幾乎什麼都能用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mediums, then. Where do they roam?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmidɪəmz ðɛn wɛɹ du ðeɪ ɹoʊm/
dialogue.zh: 那給我中號。雞平常在哪裡跑？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Free-range, out behind the red barn.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌfri ˈreɪndʒ aʊt bɪˈhaɪnd ðə rɛd bɑɹn/
dialogue.zh: 自由放養，就在紅色穀倉後面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's why the shells are so strong.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts waɪ ðə ʃɛlɑɹz ɑɹ soʊ stɹɔŋ/
dialogue.zh: 難怪蛋殼這麼硬。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Some buyers say you can taste it.
dialogue.phonetic: /sʌm ˈbaɪərz seɪ ju kæn teɪst ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 有人說吃起來真的不一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I can't tell, honestly. My wife can.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kænt tɛl ˈɑnəstli maɪ waɪf kæn/
dialogue.zh: 老實說我吃不出來，我太太可以。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She has good taste in eggs.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi hæz ɡʊd teɪst ɪn ɛɡz/
dialogue.zh: 她很會挑蛋呢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Half a dozen might be better today.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf ə ˈdʌzən maɪt bi ˈbɛɾɚ təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 今天半打或許剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Changed your mind? Half is four fifty.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃeɪndʒd jɚ maɪnd hæf ɪz fɔɹ ˈfɪfti/
dialogue.zh: 改主意啦？半打四塊五。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And a dozen is nine, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ənd ə ˈdʌzən ɪz naɪn raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 一打是九塊，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes — only fifty cents more than half!
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈoʊnli ˈfɪfti sɛnts mɔɹ ðæn hæf/
dialogue.zh: 對，只比半打多五角。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm. I'll think about that for a second.
dialogue.phonetic: /həm aɪl θɪŋk əˈbaʊt ðæt fɚ ə ˈsɛkənd/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，讓我考慮一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No rush. These keep for weeks, you know.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ɹʌʃ ðiːz kip fɚ wiːks ju noʊ/
dialogue.zh: 不用急，這些蛋能放好幾週。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Really? I always refrigerate mine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɹɪli aɪ ˈɔlˌweɪz rɪˈfɹɪdʒəˌɹeɪt maɪn/
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？我每次都冰在冰箱。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Farm-fresh eggs don't need the fridge.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɑɹm fɹɛʃ ɛɡz doʊnt nid ðə fɹɪdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 農場的新鮮蛋不用放冰箱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, that's one less kitchen chore.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl ðæts wʌn lɛs ˈkɪtʃən tʃɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，廚房又少一件事了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We also have duck eggs, try one!
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ˈɔlsoʊ hæv dʌk ɛɡz traɪ wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 我們也有鴨蛋，來試試！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Duck eggs? Are they bigger?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌk ɛɡz ɑɹ ðeɪ ˈbɪɡɚ/
dialogue.zh: 鴨蛋？比較大嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Richer yolks — great for pancakes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɹɪtʃɚ jɔks ɡɹeɪt fɚ ˈpænˌkeɪks/
dialogue.zh: 蛋黃更香，做鬆餅最好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My grandkids will fight over pancakes!
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈɡɹændˌkɪdz wɪl faɪt ˈoʊvɚ ˈpænˌkeɪks/
dialogue.zh: 孫子們為了鬆餅一定搶起來！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Saturday morning, then? Pancake day?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsætɚˌdeɪ ˈmɔɹnɪŋ ðɛn ˈpænˌkeɪk deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 是週六早上嗎？鬆餅日？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Every Saturday since they were five.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvɹi ˈsætɚˌdeɪ sɪns ðeɪ wɜɹ faɪv/
dialogue.zh: 他們從五歲起，每個週六都這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A good tradition. I love that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ɡʊd təˈɹɪʃən aɪ lʌv ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 真是個好傳統，我喜歡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, the dozen it is. Wait... oh dear.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ðə ˈdʌzən ɪt ɪz weɪt oʊ dɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 好，就一打。等等……噢，糟了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What's wrong? You look worried.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌts ɹɔŋ ju lʊk ˈwɜɹid/
dialogue.zh: 怎麼了？您看起來很擔心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I only have my card on me.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈoʊnli hæv maɪ kɑɹd ɑn mi/
dialogue.zh: 我身上只帶了卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ah — today we're cash only, sorry.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑ təˈdeɪ wɪɹ kæʃ ˈoʊli ˈsɑɹi/
dialogue.zh: 唉，今天只收現金，抱歉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I thought the app worked here.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ θɔt ði æp wɜɹkt hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 我以為可以用手機付款。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Usually yes, but today the signal's dead.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈjuːʒəwəli jɛs bət təˈdeɪ ðə ˈsɪɡnəlz dɛd/
dialogue.zh: 平常可以，今天這裡收訊很差。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The van parked in front blocks it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə væn pɑɹkt ɪn frʌnt blɑks ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 前面停的廂型車擋到了訊號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That van ruins my sales every time!
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt væn ɹuˈɪnz maɪ seɪlz ˈɛvɹi taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 那台車每次都壞我生意！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How far is the nearest ATM?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ fɑɹ ɪz ðə ˈnɪɹɪst eɪˌtiˈɛm/
dialogue.zh: 最近的提款機有多遠？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two blocks, but you'd walk back and forth.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu blɑks bət ju d wɔk bæk ənd fɔɹθ/
dialogue.zh: 兩個街口，但來回走一趟太辛苦。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My knees say no to that walk.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ niz seɪ noʊ tə ðæt wɔk/
dialogue.zh: 我的膝蓋可不答應這趟路。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What about the cash in your pocket?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt əˈbaʊt ðə kæʃ ɪn jʊɹ ˈpɑkɪt/
dialogue.zh: 您口袋裡有沒有現金？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's see... a five and some coins.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts siː ə faɪv ənd səm kɔɪnz/
dialogue.zh: 看看……一張五塊，還有零錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A five covers the half dozen just fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə faɪv ˈkʌvɚz ðə hæf ˈdʌzən dʒʌst faɪn/
dialogue.zh: 五塊錢剛好付半打。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect! Half now, the dozen next week.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜɹfɪkt hæf naʊ ðə ˈdʌzən nɛkst wiːk/
dialogue.zh: 太好了！今天先半打，下週買一打。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Deal. Want two extra cartons to carry them?
dialogue.phonetic: /diːl wɑnt tu ˈɛkstɹə ˈkɑɹtnz tə ˈkæɹi ðɛm/
dialogue.zh: 好。要不要多拿兩個蛋盒提著？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, those thick blue ones, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðoʊz θɪk blu wʌnz pliːz/
dialogue.zh: 要的，那種厚藍色的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring them back, get fifty cents each.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɹɪŋ ðɛm bæk ɡɛt ˈfɪfti sɛnts itʃ/
dialogue.zh: 退回來，一個退五角。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A carton deposit — my mom did that!
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈkɑɹtn dɪˈpɑzət maɪ mɑm dʌd ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 蛋盒押金——我媽媽以前也這樣！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My dad sold eggs from a truck for years.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ dæd soʊld ɛɡz fɹʌm ə tɹʌk fɚ jɪɹz/
dialogue.zh: 我爸開貨車賣蛋好多年。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No way! I drove trucks myself.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ weɪ aɪ draʊvd tɹʌks maɪˈsɛlf/
dialogue.zh: 太巧了！我以前也開貨車。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then you know a good egg when you see one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ju noʊ ə ɡʊd ɛɡ wɛn ju si wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 您一定很會挑蛋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha! One more thing — save me the biggest.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ wʌn mɔɹ θɪŋ seɪv mi ðə ˈbɪɡɪst/
dialogue.zh: 哈！另外，幫我留最大的那些。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Already in the carton. That's four fifty.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔlˈrɛdi ɪn ðə ˈkɑɹtn ðæts fɔɹ ˈfɪfti/
dialogue.zh: 早就放進去了，共四塊五。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here's five — keep the change, it's fair.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪɹz faɪv kip ðə tʃeɪndʒ ɪts fɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 這五塊，找頭請留著，很公道。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you! Same stall, every Saturday?
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju seɪm stɔl ˈɛvɹi ˈsætɚˌdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝！每週六都在這個攤位嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You bet. I'll bring cash and my grandkids.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju bɛt aɪl brɪŋ kæʃ ənd maɪ ˈɡɹændˌkɪdz/
dialogue.zh: 當然，我會帶現金和孫子們來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll think up new pancake tricks for them.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl θɪŋk ʌp nju ˈpænˌkeɪk tɹɪks fɚ ðɛm/
dialogue.zh: 我幫他們想鬆餅的新花樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You're the best. Have a great market day!
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹ ðə bɛst hæv ə ɡɹeɪt ˈmɑɹkɪt deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 您人真好，今天生意興隆！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Drive safe — wait, you walked here?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɹaɪv seɪf weɪt ju wɔkt hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 開車慢點——咦，您是走路來的？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Of course! The cart makes it easy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv ˈkɔɹs ðə kɑɹt meɪks ɪt ˈizi/
dialogue.zh: 當然！有推車就輕鬆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then enjoy the pancakes, see you Saturday!
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ɛnˈdʒɔɪ ðə ˈpænˌkeɪks si ju ˈsætɚˌdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 那就祝您鬆餅吃得開心，週六見！

script.youtube_title: 【只收現金】「出門沒帶現金怎麼辦？」市集買蛋記｜🎧60句聽力｜一打半打、鴨蛋鬆餅、蛋盒押金｜A2初級｜不用背多聽就會用｜Market Day Eggs
script.youtube_title_en: "Today We're Cash Only" — Buying Eggs at the Farmers Market
script.youtube_description:
攤商說只收現金，口袋只有五塊錢怎麼辦？這段「農夫市集買蛋」美式英語聽力最貼近生活！🎧

一位老先生來買雞蛋，先糾結一打還是半打，又聽聞鴨蛋做鬆餅特別香，結果結帳時才發現身上只有卡。攤位收訊又差，怎麼辦？你會聽到一段溫暖又實用的市集對話。

這一集重現週六農夫市集的蛋攤：問尺寸、聊放養、談存放、現金不夠的應變、蛋盒押金與下次光顧。每句都不超過十個詞，A2 初級也能聽得津津有味。

你會聽到：
🔸 買蛋開場：I'll take a dozen, please.
🔸 現金危機：Today we're cash only, sorry.
🔸 變通之道：What about the cash in your pocket?
🔸 押金舊俗：Bring them back, get fifty cents each.

🎧 後半段是逐句聽力加跟讀練習，同一句先聽母語語調，再開口複製一次，把這六十句聽到會說。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背，多聽就會用，量詞、零錢、攤位聊天全都學。

看完記得按讚、訂閱並打開小鈴鐺，每週新增一段生活情境聽力。留言告訴我們：你家的傳統市場收現金還是收卡？

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
script.youtube_description_en: The vendor says cash only, and all you have is a card and a five-dollar bill. This A2 American English listening practice brings you to a sunny farmers market egg stand, where a friendly shopper debates a dozen or just half, discovers duck eggs for Saturday pancakes, and finds a pocket solution when the card reader fails. Listen to natural market English: dozens and halves, free-range talk, how long eggs keep, carton deposits, and small change. Every sentence is short and warm, perfect for beginners who want real conversation practice. The second half of the video is a sentence-by-sentence listen-and-repeat session, turning sixty lines into speaking confidence. Subscribe for a new daily-life dialogue every week, and tell us: what do you always buy at your local market?
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🎧市集英文｜一打與半打・只收現金・蛋盒押金｜聽完就能說｜🌱A2初級英文｜💡不用背多聽就會用
script.youtube_description_ref:

這一集帶大家走進週六的農夫市集蛋攤，看一位老先生和攤主從挑蛋、聊雞，一路聊到做鬆餅的週六傳統。
你會聽到：
🔸 買蛋開場｜「I'll take a dozen, please.」用打和半打講清數量。
🔸 現金危機｜「Today we're cash only, sorry.」聽懂攤商的難處。
🔸 變通說法｜「What about the cash in your pocket?」學習不尷尬的解決方式。

後半段是逐句聽力加跟讀練習 🎧 先聽母語語調，再開口複製，把這六十句市集英語聽到會說。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背，多聽就會用，下次逛市場就能直接開口聊。
